description: Checks whether ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity can reach and understand a business website: robots.txt rules for AI crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended), llms.txt, text visible without JavaScript, schema.org labels for the organisation and prices, sitemap, FAQ, pricing and comparison pages. Returns a 0-100 score, grade, each problem with a concrete fix, fixes ranked by impact, and a link to the full report. Use when someone asks 'why doesn't ChatGPT recommend my business', 'is my site blocking AI', 'is my website ready for AI search / GEO / AEO', or 'how do I get my site cited by AI'.
name: check_ai_search_readiness
title: Check AI search readiness
